notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only sources are the FFLA California lists (by county and alphabetical) and the FFLA Unknown/Undocumented table, which draws on Thornton's book. Two searches found nothing about a Forebay lookout; hits were a 2015 Forebay Fire in Merced County and Stanislaus NF lookouts that are not this site. Forest Lookouts has no Forebay entry. Story body is about 80 words, short of the guide's usual 120 for thin sources, because nothing more is sourced; it was not padded. Record fields agree with the FFLA row (county, coordinates, Gone). Worth trying: Stanislaus NF lookout inventory or heritage files, Tuolumne County Historical Society, Thornton's book.
